sermon.title: Burning bush, The Fire - December 3, 2023
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: After worship inviting the Spirit, the message teaches from the burning bush that God’s Spirit is always burning, but we must turn aside, look and listen. Samuel, the two on the road to Emmaus, Peter on the water and Simeon all responded, and when we respond His word, power and presence come. It also warns that a law is not right just because government made it.

faqs.question: What if I need to be torn down?
faqs.answer: The prayer asks the Spirit to do His work in us, whatever it is.

faqs.question: What did the woman at the well say?
faqs.answer: Come see a man who told me all things that I ever did.

scriptures.text_nkjv: “Come, see a Man who told me all things that I ever did. Could this be the Christ?”

faqs.question: What is his Walmart example?
faqs.answer: He says you can steal up to a certain amount and walk right out, so everyone is on the honor system.

faqs.question: Is everything legal now?
faqs.answer: He says sex with children is thankfully still not allowed, but much else is legal.

faqs.question: What does he joke about Luke and Cleopas?
faqs.answer: That Luke heard this and didn’t ask Cleopas to write down everything Jesus said.

faqs.question: How should we read the Old Testament?
faqs.answer: Understand that a lot of it points to Jesus.

faqs.question: Is discipleship easy?
faqs.answer: No; disciples and missionaries face obstacles, and it takes work.

faqs.question: Should we criticize Peter for sinking?
faqs.answer: At least he went out; even if you make a mistake out there God will lift you up.

faqs.question: What did those in the boat say?
faqs.answer: You are the Son of God, not just a prophet.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then those who were in the boat came and worshiped Him, saying, “Truly You are the Son of God.”

faqs.question: What does the closing prayer ask?
faqs.answer: That God would magnify a service like this on a large scale.
